$comment: The official plugins (the ones DeckPilot bundles) built here, and the permission policy each must keep (official/README.md). `plugins` are released (signed, one GitHub Release per version); `fixtures` are built, packaged, signed with throwaway keys and compared with DeckPilot's build in CI only, never released. `permissions` is the exact set of permission kinds a plugin's manifest may declare: anything else, and every plugin API 1.9 privileged kind while the gate is closed, fails tools/check-official.py, unless the plugin is `held` (the reason, as text): then its source is on main, built, tested and compared, and its package, signatures, release and Marketplace entry are refused.

plugins.held: the tools permission (process execution, the docker executable only), the resources permission and resource action parameters are plugin API 1.9 privileged kinds: no package, signature, release or Marketplace entry until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate

the tools permission (process execution, the git executable only), the resources permission and resource action parameters are plugin API 1.9 privileged kinds: no package, signature, release or Marketplace entry until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate

the projectContext, resources and hostViews permissions, node.changesContext actions, host:project.* variable sources, the projects host view, statusItems and dashboardCards are plugin API 1.9 privileged kinds: no package, signature, release or Marketplace entry until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate

hostViews and the workflows host view are plugin API 1.9 privileged kinds: no package, signature, release or Marketplace entry until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate

the resources permission, resource action parameters and openUrl.fromParams are plugin API 1.9 privileged kinds: no package, signature, release or Marketplace entry until the security review of DeckPilot docs/marketplace/publisher-review-request.md opens the gate
